description: A jQuery plugin for image cropping, defining the $.Jcrop object with methods for initializing, configuring, and handling image crop interactions, including modules for touch support, coordinate management, shading, selection, tracking, and keyboard controls.

classes.name: Coords
classes.description: Manages the coordinates of the crop selection, including fixed aspect ratio calculations, boundary enforcement, and coordinate flipping.

classes.name: Shade
classes.description: Handles the shaded overlay outside the crop selection, including enabling/disabling, resizing, and opacity control.

classes.name: Selection
classes.description: Manages the crop selection rectangle, including creation, updating, showing/hiding, and handling user interactions.

classes.name: Tracker
classes.description: Handles mouse and touch tracking for dragging and resizing the crop area.

classes.name: KeyManager
classes.description: Manages keyboard interactions for nudging and controlling the crop selection.

classes.name: Touch
classes.description: Detects touch support and provides touch-specific event handling for drag and selection.

methods.name: setImage
methods.description: Sets or updates the image to be cropped.

methods.name: animateTo
methods.description: Animates the crop selection to a specified rectangle.

methods.name: tellScaled
methods.description: Returns the current scaled selection rectangle.

methods.name: setClass
methods.description: Sets the CSS class for the crop container.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes the crop interface and cleans up.

methods.name: getBounds
methods.description: Returns the dimensions of the image.

methods.name: getWidgetSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the widget.

methods.name: getScaleFactor
methods.description: Returns the scale factors for the image.
